Ravi (AE): Heads-up, client NovaLedger wants a 2-week sandbox POC: hybrid semantic search + assistant for support docs. They quoted traffic ~300k events/day. Need an ops/cost plan and a security checklist for procurement by tomorrow.
Jules (Solutions): Quick split ask: are those events mostly lookups or interactive chat? Also curious about retention/ingest cadence.
Ravi (AE): They expect ~220k vector lookups (recall) + ~80k chat turns. Ingest will be daily batches of ~200k new docs on day 0 and then ~20k/day deltas. They warned about weekly sync job that causes a 5x spike for ~15 minutes.
Sofia (ML Eng): Need token footprints. Any sample prompt/answer sizes?
Ravi (AE): Sample says user prompt ~250 tokens, assistant reply ~500 tokens, we attach top-3 docs per chat (~150 tokens each).
Sofia (ML Eng): So per chat turn = 250 + 500 + (3*150) = 1,300 tokens. 80k chats/day => ~104M gen tokens/day. Embedding ingest: initial 200k docs -> embedding compute one-time; lookups are cheap but need vector DB throughput.
Marco (Infra): QPS: 300k/day ~= 3.5 rps average, 5x spike -> ~17.5 rps peak. For 1.0s p95 target on generation path with 1.3k tokens/turn, recommended infra: 1x H100 (preferred) or 3x A10G (cost-optimized) with continuous batching and warm pools. For POC, a small dedicated pool with fast autoscale is recommended.
Jules (Solutions): Can you give a POC cost sketch (2 weeks) hosted vs dedicated? Include vector DB cost.
Sofia (ML Eng): Hosted estimate: generation tokens = 104M/day *14 = 1.456B tokens. Use example rate $0.018 / 1K tokens => gen ~$26,208. Embeddings: initial 200k * $0.0005 = $100 one-time, plus 20k/day deltas *14 = 280k * $0.0005 = $140 -> total embed compute ~$240. Vector DB ops (lookups): 220k/day lookups -> assume $0.00001 / lookup => $2,420 over 14 days. Total hosted ballpark: ~$29k after network and margin.
Marco (Infra): Dedicated estimate: short-term reserved H100-equivalent instance(s) + vector DB throughput. H100 rental + infra & ops for 2 weeks =~ $16k-$22k depending on spot. Vector DB managed throughput ~ $2k for the period. Recommend quoting Dedicated ~$24k conservative.
Jules (Solutions): For the slide present Hosted ~$33k and Dedicated ~$24k to be conservative and include a 25% buffer. Note savings options: reduce top-k to 1-2, chunk docs smaller, or use caching on retrieval.
Ravi (AE): They insist on p95 <= 1s for interactive flows. Is that realistic?
Sofia (ML Eng): Achievable with these levers: (1) prefix/KV cache to serve repeated conversational prefixes, (2) early-exit reranking to reduce generation, (3) quantized int8 model variant for faster throughput. If we get good cache hit rates (30%+), token generation cost and latency drop substantially.
Marco (Infra): Example runtime snippet to include in ops runbook:
```
# POC pool suggestion (YAML-like)
pool: novaledger-poc
min_replicas: 1
max_replicas: 5
gpu_type: H100
batching:
  max_tokens: 4096
  timeout_ms: 8
cache:
  enabled: true
  kv_capacity: 8GB
fallbacks:
  - model_variant: quant-int8
  - route: lower-cost-region
```
Marco (Infra): With batching timeout 8ms we keep per-request overhead low and the warm pool handles spikes. Also provision vector DB with 500 qps headroom for sync spikes.
Tess (Security): Client sent a vendor security questionnaire. Key asks: data residency (EU only), KMS/HSM integration, retention windows, PCI/PII handling, and audit log delivery. If they require EU residency and Private deployment, lead time ~4-6 weeks for VPC/on-prem. For POC we can offer hosted with strict EU tenancy and bring-your-own-key (BYOK) options where possible.
Ravi (AE): Can security + legal answer the questionnaire before kickoff Fri?
Tess (Security): We'll draft canned responses for hosted with EU tenancy and note Private timeline. Legal to review DPA addendum. Ill place the draft in the ticket.
Jules (Solutions): Proposed POC success criteria to align with client: (1) 1.0s p95 for 85% of interactive traffic, (2) recall@3 >= 0.8 on their eval set, (3) delta ingest throughput >= 25k docs/hr, (4) POC cost within quoted budget. Any additions?
Sofia (ML Eng): Add automated nightly eval + a rollback trigger on quality drop >5% absolute. Also add latency SLOs for vector lookup (p95 < 100ms).
Ravi (AE): I'll include these in the presales brief. Link to questionnaire: https://drive.company/novaledger/vendor-q
Jules (Solutions): Can infra produce a 1-page operator runbook (deploy, scale steps, obs queries, rollback) and a short cost table by tomorrow morning?
Marco (Infra): I'll post a gist with the runbook and cost calc. OpsBot: create ticket POC-4021 and attach calendar invite for Monday 09:30.
OpsBot: Ticket POC-4021 created; invite sent.
Ravi (AE): Thanks team, I'll send the client the conservative budgets and the security caveats. Update thread if anything changes.
Jules (Solutions): :thumbsup:
Tess (Security): Draft uploaded to ticket.
Sofia (ML Eng): I'll attach a simple eval harness and example metrics to the ticket by EOD.
